$comment: Ceilings for npm run audit:event-client, judged only against a built deploy (--base). Measured on production 2026-11-03 from a shared 32-core box with software GL: chromium (emulated iPhone 14, 120 s) world visible 5.2 s, 14.2 MB transferred, 125 MB peak heap, 0 MB growth, worst walking frame 1.7 s; webkit world visible 4.4-6.0 s, 13.1-15.9 MB (WebKit exposes no heap, and its CPU WebGL rasteriser freezes the page before the walk). Headroom covers a busy machine; tighten when a performance fix lands.
